name: rss-reading-list
description: Check several RSS/Atom feeds, keep only articles you haven't seen before, and append them to a Markdown reading list.

feeds.description: Comma-separated RSS or Atom feed URLs

max_items.description: Maximum number of new articles added per run (newest first)

output_file.description: Markdown file the new articles are appended to

state_key.description: Where the IDs of already-seen articles are remembered

notify_channel.description: Optional OpenClaw channel for a short summary (telegram, slack, discord, feishu...)

notify_target.description: Optional chat id / channel id for notify_channel

steps.run: curl -fsSL --max-time 30 -A 'openclaw-cookbook' "$FEED_URL" | node -e 'let xml = ""; try { xml = require("fs").readFileSync(0, "utf8") } catch (e) {} const decode = s => s.replace(/<!\[CDATA\[([\s\S]*?)\]\]>/g, "$1").replace(/<[^>]+>/g, "").replace(/</g, "<").replace(/>/g, ">").replace(/"/g, String.fromCharCode(34)).replace(/'|'/g, String.fromCharCode(39)).replace(/&#(\d+);/g, (m, n) => String.fromCharCode(Number(n))).replace(/&/g, "&").replace(/\s+/g, " ").trim(); const tag = (block, name) => { const m = block.match(new RegExp("<" + name + "[^>]*>([\\s\\S]*?)</" + name + ">", "i")); return m ? decode(m[1]) : "" }; const feedTitle = tag(xml.split(/<(item|entry)[\s>]/i)[0], "title") || process.env.FEED_URL; const blocks = xml.match(/<(item|entry)[\s>][\s\S]*?<\/(item|entry)>/gi) || []; const items = blocks.map(b => { const atomLink = (b.match(/<link[^>]*href=["\x27]([^"\x27]+)["\x27]/i) || [])[1]; const link = tag(b, "link") || atomLink || ""; const date = tag(b, "pubDate") || tag(b, "published") || tag(b, "updated") || tag(b, "dc:date"); const ts = Date.parse(date) || 0; return { id: tag(b, "guid") || tag(b, "id") || link, title: tag(b, "title") || "(untitled)", link, ts, feed: feedTitle } }).filter(i => i.id); console.log(JSON.stringify({ url: process.env.FEED_URL, ok: blocks.length > 0, count: items.length, items }))'

node -e 'const results = JSON.parse(require("fs").readFileSync(0, "utf8")).map(r => r.items); let saved = JSON.parse(process.env.SEEN || "null"); if (Array.isArray(saved)) saved = saved[0]; const seen = (saved && saved.ids) || []; const known = new Set(seen); const all = results.flatMap(r => r.items); const failed = results.filter(r => !r.ok).map(r => r.url); const unique = [...new Map(all.map(i => [i.id, i])).values()]; const fresh = unique.filter(i => !known.has(i.id)).sort((a, b) => b.ts - a.ts); const picked = fresh.slice(0, Number(process.env.LOBSTER_ARG_MAX_ITEMS)); const remember = { ids: [...new Set([...unique.map(i => i.id), ...seen])].slice(0, 2000) }; console.log(JSON.stringify({ total: unique.length, newCount: fresh.length, picked, failed, remember }))'

node -e 'const fs = require("fs"); const path = require("path"); const r = JSON.parse(process.env.FRESH); const file = process.env.LOBSTER_ARG_OUTPUT_FILE.replace(/^~(?=/|$)/, require("os").homedir()); if (r.picked.length) { fs.mkdirSync(path.dirname(file), { recursive: true }); const lines = ["", "## " + new Date().toISOString().slice(0, 10) + " (" + r.picked.length + " new)", ""]; r.picked.forEach(i => lines.push("- [ ] [" + i.title.replace(/[\[\]]/g, "") + "](" + i.link + ") — *" + i.feed + "*")); fs.appendFileSync(file, (fs.existsSync(file) ? "" : "# Reading list
") + lines.join("
") + "
") } const msg = [r.picked.length ? "📚 " + r.picked.length + " new articles added to " + file + (r.newCount > r.picked.length ? " (" + (r.newCount - r.picked.length) + " more skipped by max_items)" : "") : "No new articles since last time."]; r.picked.slice(0, 5).forEach(i => msg.push("• " + i.title)); r.failed.forEach(u => msg.push("⚠️ Could not read " + u)); console.log(JSON.stringify({ added: r.picked.length, message: msg.join("
"), file }))'
if [ -n "$LOBSTER_ARG_NOTIFY_CHANNEL" ]; then openclaw message send --channel "$LOBSTER_ARG_NOTIFY_CHANNEL" --target "$LOBSTER_ARG_NOTIFY_TARGET" --message "$MSG" >&2; fi; printf '%s\n' "$MSG"
